labelProvenance.calibrationEligibility: Excluded until item-level and subset-level human attestation.

requiredHumanAttestation.itemStatement: I personally reviewed this item under the identified rubric version and SHA-256 digest and set or confirmed the final label. Any AI-produced draft label was treated only as provisional.
requiredHumanAttestation.subsetStatement: I attest that every eligible calibration item has a named human reviewer, timestamp, rubric version and digest, and final human label.

publicationRule: Judge results remain UNCALIBRATED and cannot rank arms until human-attested labels produce the required agreement, kappa, confusion counts, and denominators.
